plugin.name: Instant Memo
plugin.description: AI self-memo and proactive reminders: status memos are injected into the model context while valid; one-off/daily/workday/interval schedules are announced by the AI when due.
entry.list_items.name: List Memos and Tasks
entry.list_items.description: List all status memos and scheduled tasks with item IDs, validity and next trigger times.
entry.add_status_memo.name: Add Status Memo
entry.add_status_memo.description: Create or overwrite a status memo that stays in effect as the AI's private memo while valid.
entry.add_status_memo.param.minutes_late: Validity in minutes. Use 0 or -1 for permanent. Default 60.
entry.add_status_memo.param.memo_id: Existing memo ID (8-char prefix works too); pass it to overwrite instead of creating. Leave empty to create.
entry.add_scheduled_task.name: Add Scheduled Task
entry.add_scheduled_task.description: Create or overwrite a scheduled reminder or repeating task; the AI announces it when due.
entry.add_scheduled_task.param.schedule_: Minutes for one_off/interval (e.g. '30'); HH:MM for daily/workday (e.g. '12:30').
entry.add_scheduled_task.param.task_id: Existing task ID (8-char prefix works too); pass it to overwrite instead of creating. Leave empty to create.
entry.delete_item.name: Delete Item
entry.delete_item.description: Delete a status memo or scheduled task by item ID (8-char prefix works too).
entry.delete_item.param.item_id: Item ID or 8-char short ID to delete.
entry.update_item.name: Update Item
entry.update_item.description: Update an item's fields. Memos support content/expire; tasks support desc/value/type.
entry.update_item.param.item_id: Item ID or 8-char short ID to update.
entry.update_item.param.field: Field name: memo content/expire; task desc/value/type.
ui.main.title: Instant Memo
actions.delete_item.label: Delete
